Join Happy Paws <Vet> & Co?

Happy Paws <Vet> & Co invited you to join their team on ToothOps. Sign in with your existing account to accept.

Nothing changes until you accept — and sharing your existing charts with the practice is a separate choice you make when joining.

Review invitation
If the button doesn’t work, copy this link into your browser:
https://toothops.app/#/join/abc.def?x=1&y="2"

The link works for 14 days. If you weren’t expecting this, ignore this email.
